title: Mi historia

source.title: Spanish beginner story 1 (course-authored)
source.author: Go course authors (first draft by an AI assistant at the authors’ request)

sourceNote: Written for the course authors as a beginner seed text. The drafter was an AI assistant (Claude), not a native speaker: the text is simple and deliberately repetitive but has NOT been reviewed by a native speaker and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English glosses are the drafter's own. Have a native speaker review it before release.

sentences.text: Cuando era joven, yo no entendía mi corazón.
sentences.english: When I was young, I did not understand my heart.

sentences.text: Cuando era joven, yo tenía pecado en mi corazón.
sentences.english: When I was young, I had sin in my heart.
I did not believe in God.

sentences.text: Un día empecé a entender mi pecado.
sentences.english: One day I began to understand my sin.

sentences.text: Ahora tengo paz en mi corazón.
sentences.english: Now I have peace in my heart.

sentences.text: Ahora entiendo que Dios perdona a todos.
sentences.english: Now I understand that God forgives everyone.
